title: Career Roadmap: Policy Analyst
summary: Research public issues, evaluate government programmes, analyse socioeconomic data and develop evidence-based recommendations to support public policy, institutional strategy and social development.

facts.Current degree: Integrated / Dual-Degree Programmes (BS-MS, B.Tech+M.Tech, B.Sc-M.Sc, BA-MA)

about.label: Education Pathway
about.text: Integrated / Dual-Degree Programmes – Integrated MA (Economics / English / Development Studies)

blocks.text: Research public issues, evaluate government programmes, analyse socioeconomic data and develop evidence-based recommendations to support public policy, institutional strategy and social development.

rows.text: Any stream; Economics, Political Science, Mathematics and Sociology are useful
Relevant bachelor's degree or an eligible integrated programme
Integrated MA in Economics, Development Studies, Public Policy or a related discipline
Public finance, education policy, health policy, climate policy, governance or social protection

blocks.label: Alternative pathways
blocks.text: BA/B.Sc. Economics, Political Science, Sociology or Statistics followed by a master's in Public Policy, Development Studies or Economics.

blocks.label: Policy Research
blocks.text: Literature reviews, policy briefs and stakeholder analysis.

blocks.label: Data Analysis
blocks.text: Excel, statistics, survey analysis and introductory Python or R.

blocks.label: Economic Understanding
blocks.text: Public finance, economic indicators and programme evaluation.

blocks.label: Writing & Communication
blocks.text: Clear reports, executive summaries and presentations.

blocks.label: Critical Thinking
blocks.text: Assessing policy trade-offs, implementation challenges and unintended consequences.
Develop practical evidence of policy-analysis skills through:

items.text: A policy brief on education, employment, healthcare or urban development.
A data-based analysis of a government programme.
A comparison of policy approaches across two states or countries.
A stakeholder map identifying affected communities and institutions.
A monitoring framework with measurable policy outcomes.

blocks.text: Seek internships or research placements at:

items.text: Public policy research organisations and think tanks.
Government departments and public-sector research units.
Consulting firms working on government and social-sector projects.
Excel, Power BI, R or Python for data analysis.
GIS fundamentals for regional or urban policy research.

blocks.text: Build a portfolio of written policy briefs and data analyses alongside certifications.
Senior Policy Analyst → Policy Lead / Research Director
Progression depends on research quality, subject expertise, experience and the employer's recruitment criteria.

rows.text: Choose a policy domain and study existing policies, official reports and relevant datasets.
Create a policy brief and conduct a small data-analysis or programme-evaluation project.
Build a writing portfolio, prepare a research-focused résumé and apply for internships or junior research roles.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Strong research and writing ability, data literacy, understanding of public institutions, policy-evaluation skills and a portfolio demonstrating evidence-based recommendations.
